svg.aria-label: Toolbox: Unity (Engine) — Game engine for 2D and 3D games. One of my three engines. Godot (Engine) — Open-source game engine. Small, fast and scriptable. Unreal Engine (Engine) — Game engine for high-end 3D and real-time graphics. Blender (3D) — 3D modelling, sculpting and rendering. Photoshop (Graphics) — Graphics, textures and image editing. Code (Learning) — Learning to code, one project at a time.
